reviews.text:
Paradise Ranch Pet Resort has been our trusted home away from home for over two years for both daycare and boarding. My English Mastiff, Lina, is a certified therapy dog, so her temperament, comfort, and well-being are incredibly important to me — and Paradise Ranch has consistently exceeded expectations.

Most recently, Lina stayed for a 9-day boarding visit, the longest she’s ever been away from home. She came back relaxed, happy, and well cared for, with no soreness or stress — which speaks volumes about the thoughtful, attentive care she receives. The staff truly knows the dogs, understands large breeds, and treats each one like family.

The environment is calm, enriching, and well managed, and the communication always gives me complete peace of mind while I’m away. I am so grateful for the incredible team at Paradise Ranch and wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dog.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional daycare and boarding.

🐾💙

My dog Rocky loves Paradise! When I first got him he was very skittish about day care, but he took to Paradise Ranch right away. Whether it's day care or the occasional boarding, it's ALWAYS our go-to spot. I really don't know what I'd do without them. They're the best. And they have a groomer, too, so if you want your furry friend smelling good when you pick them up, they got you covered there too!

I have tried almost every day care out there and honestly this is BY FAR the best day care out there in So Cal. I live in West Hollywood and make the commute because I truly want the best for my dog. Dogs should be outdoors and not confined. There are also multiple play areas, which I love about this place. This place does not put dogs in cages at any point of the day, which I like as well because why even place them in day care at that point? My dog truly gets excited when we enter through to the gate and I love their system of having someone there outside in a separate gated area to pick up/drop off your dog, without having to go to the office (unless you need to). Its a quick drop off/pick up and is truly a Disneyland for the dogs. Also, I was away for a weekend and left my dog with them for boarding for three days. I wasn't worried for a second during my trip and they updated me with some pictures showing how much fun she was having. If you want the best for your dog, seriously look no further. This place is the BEST. Midhi, the manager, and Jamie have been AMAZING and I can't thank them enough for everything. I feel so good at work knowing my dog is in the best hands and having so much fun as well. In my opinion, there is no place out there that remotely compares to this day care. Definitely check it out if you're looking not for just any day care, but the right day care for your dog. Truly the best.

The entire staff has been friendly and kind every time we have ever interacted. Trainers are knowledgeable and the folks taking care of the dogs seem patient and experienced. Paradise Ranch is the only dog boarding and daycare facility that I experience zero concerns when we drop our dog, Teddy, off given their track record. Keep up the good work!
I used to take my dog here nearly every day for about a year until I moved out of the area. Cannot recommend them enough! My dog absolutely loved it here.

Couldn’t be happier every time I pick her up! I have been using their daycare service for a year ish now and the staff have been nothing but friendly and caring towards my dog. I’ve also used their boarding service. Everything is genuinely cage free, and I am more than impressed on how they handle so many dogs in one place without any commotion. I have used other daycare services where the dogs are barking like crazy and fights break out. The staff clearly have control over the situation and our trained on how to manage multiple dogs. I rarely even hear the dogs bark when I’m there to pick her up and drop her off. They also have cameras throughout the entire facility so you can check up on your dogs and how the staff is handling them at any point day or night.

The most important thing is that overall her social skills have improved tremendously, and, she is calmer and more attentive at home 10 out of 10 recommend! Also recommend their training program.
Best boarding facility ever. Professional, safe, friendly. My family and I have take our dogs there for 25 years. Highly recommend.
This is a great place to leave your dog, when you are away, there are rooms as well as water fall and pools for hot days

WOW! Does Paradise Ranch have a cloning machine and stored my original dogs in the basement? These are not my baby girls, but I will keep them!!

About 6 weeks ago I adopted littermate husky puppies. I, unfortunately (let be real… I was fortunate) had to leave for a race 3 weeks after getting them and scrambled to find a boarding that would meet our needs and expectations. My relationship depended on it!

I found Paradise Ranch less than a week before I had to leave. They were quick to respond, and we immediately began the evaluation and orientation process. I’ll be honest, I am a helicopter dog-mom, and was nervous to hand my babies off to “strangers”. I also did not want to leave them with my fiancé because I didn’t want him to hate me while I was away for two weeks!!

Everyone at Paradise Ranch was so nice and welcoming, Mihdi was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating, especially with the short time frame. I was worried my girls wouldn’t pass the evaluation, but Paradise Ranch found the right group for them (smaller dogs), and we agreed to do the 4 hour mandatory day care the day before I board them.

I’m embarrassed to say I was everything I didn’t think I would be. Maybe it was the race nerves, maybe I am just a little too excited and was bummed I had to part ways with them. I watched the cameras like a HAWK! My babies looked like they were having a blast — never did I see them sad or withdrawn. I think they would have won the naughtiest little girls award.

With my desperation for the 14 day Board & Train, I was terrified the girls would not return home better than I left them. I became the crazy mom emailing and texting… and let me tell you — it was totally unnecessary!

Despite my excitement when I returned home, I allowed myself to settle in (and did not watch the cameras the final two days!!), and picked them up in the scheduled day. My trip was only 12 days, but we agreed it was best to give me those two days and let the entire session complete.

On pick up day, I did not believe the dogs brought out were my girls. Bowie, my strong-willed “what’s in it for me” girl came out Heeling!! HUSKIES DON’T Heel!! Or so i’ve been told. She listened to all the commands when first told and still does! Everest, my excitable baby was able to contain her excitement and follow through the commands.

We are now 48 hours home, the girls are settling in and we are continuing to work on the new rules/commands. It’s completely changed the energy of our entire home, and I not longer fear my fiancé will hate me for getting the two instead of 1. We have two more private sessions, and I cannot wait to see my babies become the goddess little naughty girls in the dog world 🤪

I will definitely keep Paradise Ranch in my back pocket for refreshers or when I travel for races again… I won’t be glued to the cameras next time around either!

Thank you Paradise Ranch for taking care of my babies and putting up with my insanity!

I was pretty disappointed with my experience at paradise pet resorts. The facilities are great, lots of space, play areas even little pools for the dogs but the customer service really fell short. From the moment I dropped off my pup, the staff seemed distant and not very welcoming, which was stressful.
On top of that, communication was a problem. I didn’t get updates about my dog’s stay and when I reached out, responses were slow and vague. It left me feeling uneasy the whole time.
It’s too bad, because the concept and the facilities are fantastic. If they improve the way they interact with pet owners and provide timely updates, this place could easily deserve five stars. For now, though, I can’t wholeheartedly recommend it.

Our go-to spot for daycare and long term boarding. We love that the dogs are able to roam free all day and night! They take really great care of the dogs here. The proof is in the pudding, our girl is always pulling to get IN when we bring her!

Daisy went to daycare and boarding and also had baths here quite often. She loved coming here and couldn’t wait to run inside. I couldn’t ask for a better place. Excellent service and they truly care for our pets.

We have been bringing our 1ish year old lab here for both daycare and boarding. We love all of the cameras we have access to when she is there. During boarding bedtimes you can see all the dogs sleeping on all the cots! Pretty fun. Our dog always seems excited to be dropped off. They will even groom/bathe your dog if you ask which is super nice after they’ve been there for boarding!

It’s been years since we’ve been here. We came back with a new furry friend. We were dog sitting and needed help during the holidays and everyone there is super nice. They have cameras all over the place and you can view it if you wanna see how your little one or big one is doing. What I forgot about, is that you have to bring your own food and snacks. Not all dogs have the same diet. The one main challenge which ended up not being a challenge later on, was trying to get into the gate and leaving. For as many dogs as they had, the intercom electric gate system seem to work out well. Things to note, you have to do a assessment and they’ll see where your dog fits. I think they’re at full capacity now, but our dog got grandfathered in. We are very grateful to Management and Staff for all that they do. It is so exciting to see our little lady get to go to Paradise Ranch. Thank you for making it so much fun.
